'''Valon Rizz''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|investigator]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]] and despite being a skilled investigator himself, he was mostly hired so that [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tren Pergallis]] could showcase him as an example of how far a native could go within the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
